source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To check if supported OS can be installed onto single M.2 and booted successfully.

1. Install the primary OS to M.2.
2. Reboot system to check boot function and OS logs.
3. Check Front Panel HDD LED (If have for Tower Server) status.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. should no error message related to M.2.
2. Front HDD LED status should be OFF without IO operation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies destructive installation but does not cover exact target/boot identity or the physical front-panel LED criterion.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds media/target/partition/backup controls, operator boot/LED evidence and read-only post-checks.

historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: This Storage-SSD variant remains independently keyed despite similar M.2 wording elsewhere.

original_test_intent: For the Storage-SSD variant, install the approved primary OS on the single designated M.2/SSD target, prove the platform boots from that device without related errors and visually confirm the applicable tower front HDD LED remains off at verified idle.
original_method: Bind the installer to the exact SSD/M.2 serial and approved partition/boot recipe, perform the deployment and one controlled reboot, prove root/boot-device and log health electronically, and have a qualified operator visually document the physical front-panel HDD LED under a timestamped no-I/O condition.
manual_activity: Deployment and boot/log proof may be automated, but formal acceptance includes a physical front-panel LED observation. The operator must attest that light state at idle; the agent cannot claim it, so this complete variant is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Exact SSD/M.2 slot/serial/namespace and clarification of this Storage-SSD variant's intended form factor
Supported OS media/version/hash, drivers, unattended recipe, partition and boot-mode definition
Current data/boot inventory, backup/restore, stable power and destructive formatting approval
Tower applicability, physical LED-to-target mapping and zero/idle-I/O threshold
Qualified operator, KVM/OOB and evidence checklist
safety_requirements: Do not infer the target from a device name or drive letter; revalidate the allowlisted serial and protect all OS, mounted, in-use and data devices.
Do not clear baseline logs; preserve installer, partition and boot changes.
Stop on target mismatch, storage/installer error, failed boot, unexpected layout/logs or LED behavior.
Do not auto-reinstall, select another target, modify boot order repeatedly or infer physical LED output from counters.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target/media/partition/boot/recovery manifest and capture storage/boot baseline.
After approval, support the exact deployment and controlled reboot and collect boot-device, layout, health and log evidence.
Correlate operator-attributed LED evidence with idle I/O telemetry and report Tool Result without claiming the visual step or verdict.
engineer_actions: Clarify target form factor for this Storage-SSD variant and approve destructive install/boot scope.
Visually inspect and attest the applicable front HDD LED at idle.
Review deployment/boot/log/LED evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its high-level installer assistance is incomplete and cannot satisfy the physical LED criterion. No safe unattended command exists until target/media/partition/boot inputs are exact.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the project-approved deployment method bound to the exact serial; use read-only boot/layout/log queries as evidence and retain manual LED observation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Single-target primary OS install, reboot/log check, conditional front LED check and 10/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SERIAL-BOUND DEPLOYMENT WITH MANUAL IDLE-LED PROOF
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed deployment manifest, immutable target assertion, installer and boot provenance, post-boot storage health and synchronized operator LED evidence under measured idle conditions.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact SSD/M.2 target, OS/boot stack and tower LED wiring for this variant.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record installer/OS/kernel/driver, BIOS/BMC, drive firmware and deployment-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project OS support/deployment documentation and chassis LED specification must define this Storage-SSD variant.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact target identity and traceable evidence while preserving physical LED acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; installation, boot health and applicable LED state all remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Electronic status cannot prove emitted LED state.

project_override_considerations: The project must state whether the target is M.2 or another SSD form factor and whether a tower LED exists. A documented N/A may cover the conditional LED only; it cannot remove install/boot/log requirements.
expected_evidence: Variant-specific target serial/slot/form factor, media hash/recipe, backup and authorization
Installer transcript and exact partition/boot changes
Successful boot from the same target plus storage health and related logs
Idle I/O telemetry and operator-attributed front HDD LED evidence or documented N/A, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Storage-SSD is a broader category that can include M.2; the procedure and criteria consistently specify the M.2/LED scenario. Variant applicability requires owner input but is not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The install/boot/LED intent is clear. Missing target/media/applicability are readiness inputs; physical LED acceptance makes the case MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains deployment assistance and formatting risk but corrects PARTIAL due to formal human LED acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains target/media/backup/LED controls while applying locked MANUAL ONLY semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Independently resolves this source variant, adds form-factor applicability and prevents reuse of the other OS-install record's conclusion without verification.

review_improvement: Protects against wrong-drive installation and preserves the variant-specific physical LED criterion with explicit N/A rules.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source variant was independently read despite similarity to row 244. Its physical LED acceptance remains human-observed, so the full case is MANUAL ONLY; automatable deployment assistance does not change that classification.
